name: chip
title: Chip
description: A small pill that is a filter or a removable value.
use: A filter the reader turns on or off, as a label around a native checkbox or radio; or a value that can be removed, such as a recipient, a tag or an applied filter.

instead.when: The pill only describes something and cannot be acted on
It is one value in a form that should read as one control
It is a yes or no submitted with a form

keyboard.action: Toggles the focused filter chip, as the native input does
Move the choice along radio chips that share a name

classes.name: chip
classes.description: The pill, 28px tall: a label around a chip-input, or a plain element that holds a value

classes.name: chip-input
classes.description: The checkbox or radio inside a filter chip; it covers the chip invisibly, so the label is the target and the input keeps the state

classes.name: chip-remove
classes.description: A round remove button at the end of a value; its accessible name includes the value

states.name: checked
states.description: The chip around the input fills with ink

states.name: disabled
states.description: The chip around the input drops to a flat well with disabled ink
